harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured a persistent Squid forward proxy on node1:3128 and the preserved legacy handbook origin on node2:8081. Only HTTP requests from node2 to node2:8081 are permitted; other destinations, ports, and CONNECT tunnels return 403. Both nodes restarted sequentially and fully recovered with changed boot IDs. Alpine 3.23.3 and kernel 6.18.7-0-lts remain unchanged.
actions_performed: Installed Alpine-compatible Squid 7.6 and Python 3.12 packages.
Enabled persistent OpenRC services for Squid and the staged origin application.
Preserved the staged server and handbook files unchanged.
Validated approved GETs, wrong-port rejection, wrong-destination rejection, and CONNECT rejection before and after restarts.
Restarted node1 and node2 individually, verifying recovery before proceeding to the next node.

evidence.requirement: Forward proxy listens on node1 TCP port 3128 with the required destination policy
evidence.summary: Squid configuration parsed successfully, OpenRC reports it started, port 3128 is listening, and the active ACL permits only node2 to reach node2:8081 while denying CONNECT and all remaining traffic.

evidence.requirement: Approved handbook is reachable through the proxy from node2
evidence.summary: The proxied request returned HTTP 200 with 'Approved branch handbook, revision 3.' before and after restarts; Squid logged direct delivery from node2:8081.

evidence.requirement: Other destination ports and CONNECT tunnels are rejected
evidence.summary: Wrong port, wrong destination, and CONNECT tests all returned HTTP 403, corroborated by Squid TCP_DENIED access-log entries.

evidence.requirement: Staged origin application is preserved and persistent on node2:8081
evidence.summary: The origin runs unprivileged through OpenRC, listens on 8081, serves the exact handbook, and both staged-file hashes remained unchanged across restart.

evidence.requirement: Installed operating-system release and kernel are preserved
evidence.summary: Both nodes remained on Alpine Linux 3.23.3 with kernel 6.18.7-0-lts.

Healthy baseline boot ID 4454c4ea-3927-48f7-83d2-de3ef8fd04d7 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 6acdac69-c7e7-4cd4-9211-94341889787a observed, and the proxy plus allow/deny behavior recovered.

Healthy baseline boot ID 44da5ea0-160c-44ba-b10a-8ac9a6116478 was captured, reboot acknowledged, new boot ID 504aff37-34ac-457d-9f39-836030a61779 observed, and the origin, data, and complete proxy policy recovered.
